name: 말 편자
subject: A THICK U-SHAPED HORSESHOE in slightly tilted three-quarter view. Two broad blunt upright ends, a rounded heavy lower curve, and a generous open center connected to the outside through the top gap. Silver metal main face and one blue-gray side/thickness plane, one restrained pale edge only if useful. Broad metal arms so the shape remains chunky at 32x32, NOT a thin ring. Only TWO large dark nail marks total, one on either arm; these nail marks are SOLID charcoal recesses, not transparent holes. No nails sticking out, spikes, boot, horse, chains or many tiny rivets. It should instantly read as an actual sturdy horseshoe, not a necklace, letter U logo, magnet with colored tips or shield.

name: 각성의 약병
subject: One squat rounded GREEN TONIC BOTTLE with a SHORT WIDE CORK and substantial shoulders. A plump almost-square glass body, pale mint glass neck/edge, and light herbal-green liquid occupying most of the broad body. One darker green lower/side liquid plane suggests depth. Cork is warm tan with one muted rose-brown side. A single broad pale-mint reflection segment can identify glass; don't add multiple shiny spots. No smoke, cross, letters, fine label text, loose herbs, measuring lines, bubbles, floating cork or hanging cord. All bottle material and liquid are opaque colored pixel planes within the sprite, with transparency only outside the bottle. It should look like a compact herbal medicine flask that clears the mind, not perfume, an electric jar, a glowing orb or a goblet.

name: 나뭇잎 펜던트
subject: One LARGE GREEN LEAF-SHAPED PENDANT, a softly carved jade leaf forming almost the entire icon, with a SHORT THICK GOLDEN BAIL at the top. No necklace chain or cord. The leaf is broad and plump, rounded shoulders and a gently stepped point below, a slightly curved center vein shown by ONE broad light-green crease dividing base green and dark forest-green face planes. No many little serrations or branching veins. Gold is confined to the stout top setting/bail, NOT an ornamental rim all around the leaf. Show slight carved thickness along one side so it reads as a wearable leaf charm rather than a loose real leaf or generic gem. A tiny true opening inside the gold bail is allowed if readable, but keep it substantial and short. No dangling beads, sparkles, inscriptions or separate accessories.

name: 바람의 부채
subject: A broadly opened AQUA/MINT FOLDING FAN, a compact semicircular/fanned cloth silhouette divided into ONLY THREE broad pleated sectors. The full fan leaf occupies most of the icon, with a VERY SHORT STOUT wooden handle beneath and one small solid gold pivot. Light mint main cloth and one sky-aqua shadow plane make the three folds readable; no web of thin ribs. Tan wooden base/handle with muted rose-brown underside if needed. Upper edge is a soft wide arc with three subtle broad peaks, not many spikes. Slight diagonal stance, no wind streaks, ribbons, long tassels, feathers, lettering, floral decorations or extra objects. Make it a clear substantial physical folding fan, not a shell, wing, umbrella, flag or flat geometric symbol. The fan suggests a gentle swift breeze.
